protocol.randomization: full-strength Phase 3 domain randomization and dynamic-obstacle distribution; unseen sequence

action_diagnostics.mapping: action 0 negative requests braking and positive is a no-op; action 1 requests up to ±0.7 rad/s around the frozen route actor, subject to clearance projection and the independent protective stop

claim_boundary.supported: Phase 3 randomized Block A segments with moving ray-visible person proxies
not_supported: RTX-rendered LiDAR or depth-camera policy input
